mandate.identity/authored/oidc-refresh-g.purpose: Fork F6: a credential presented again within 2 s of its rotation yields one sibling; a third presentation revokes the family; story:oidc-refresh-and-logout.

mandate.identity/authored/oidc-refresh-r.purpose: Fork F6: a Rotated credential presented after its grace window is reuse; RefreshFamilyRevoked, and the Active successor is then refused; story:oidc-refresh-and-logout.
Fork F6: an Active credential rotates; the predecessor rests in Rotated and the successor, Active in one family, rotates in turn; story:oidc-refresh-and-logout.

mandate.identity/authored/oidc-refresh-w.purpose: A refresh credential presented by a client other than its own is denied, nothing moves, and its own client then rotates it; story:oidc-refresh-and-logout.
